in_marathi.name: Bheravi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bold, Brave, Fearless
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheravi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bheravi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Bhara’, meaning strength or power. In Hindu mythology, Bheravi is an epithet of the goddess Durga, representing fearlessness and courage. This name is ideal for parents who wish to bestow their daughter with the qualities of bravery and strength.
